mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) signals stronger supply-side activity, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite sustained INDPRO growth, or Rank IC < 0.03 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: An upward trend in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates weakening labor market conditions, reducing growth expectations and compressing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite rising UNRATE, or Rank IC > 0.03 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers monetary tightening, increasing discount rates on equity cash flows and lowering expected returns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 4.5%, or the rate does not sustain above 4.5% for the full horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate above 5% signals a weakening labor market, reducing growth prospects and compressing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE crossing above 5%, or the rate does not sustain above 5% for the full horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (easing) and rise in industrial demand (GDPC1) creates a dual signal of accommodative monetary policy and robust corporate activity, amplifying positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the combined signal, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate stronger supply-side and demand-side activity, reinforcing corporate earnings growth and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite both proxies rising, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in the federal funds rate (easing) signals central bank accommodation, boosting equity valuations and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS declining, or the effect is not sustained across the full horizon.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% reduces growth expectations and compresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 4.5%, or the rate does not sustain above 4.5% for the full horizon.
